name: claude2_1_325_allowed_control
description: Claude Code 2.1.325 Bash call captured from a real run with a capture-only hook: the command writes an unprotected file, and the guard allows it. This control shows the protected-path denials at this version come from the guard, not from a payload the guard cannot read. Version 2.1.325 adds the top-level scratchpad_dir field, which 2.1.321 did not send.

capture.sanitisation: session/prompt/tool-use ids replaced with cap-* markers; the workspace directory collapsed to /cap, transcript_path and scratchpad_dir replaced with /cap placeholders; basenames, parameter names and casing preserved exactly as emitted
